## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Python (production), LLM evaluation (golden sets, calibrated judges, CI gates), Testing (pytest), LLM APIs & tool calling.
- **Important (headline):** Eval statistics (CIs, power, pass^k), Error analysis, Experiment design & A/B testing, Retrieval quality (hybrid, reranking, recall@k), Benchmark construction, Git & CI/CD, Rubrics & inter-rater agreement.
- **Full inventory:** 65 skills (Must 5 · Important 19 · Should 28 · Optional 12 · Avoid 1), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ai-evaluation-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ai-evaluation-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Best feeders: data scientists (error analysis), PhDs (measurement rigour), backend engineers (CI, observability) [D · T0-06]
- **Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills):** AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01) (Optional: weak signal; services channels only). Whether one is worth it: [credential ROI](../../04-certifications/credential-roi.md).
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** An eval harness with a kappa-calibrated judge validated on 100+ human labels, plus position and verbosity bias tests; a CI regression threshold and a cost–quality frontier chart
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P3 Eval harness with a calibrated judge and statistics](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p3) (85%); [P1 Evaluated RAG system over a real corpus](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p1) (69%); [P4 Prompt vs RAG vs fine-tune comparison](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p4) (38%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).

## How you are interviewed

- **Track: Evaluation design.** It tests golden sets, judge calibration, online sampling, A/B tests. Source: career/02-roles/role-catalog.md §8.2 (T1-03, T0-14).
- **Practise:** the [evaluation design prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md#evaluation-design-pack), plus the behavioural and coding packs.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).

## Résumé

- **Variant:** A1 (Applied GenAI Engineering). Headline pattern: "AI Engineer | LLM systems, RAG, agents, evals".
- **Keywords to mirror, only when true:** LLM evaluation, evals, benchmarking, LLM-as-a-judge, golden dataset, A/B testing, pytest
- **Leave out or reframe:** New RAGAS dependencies (dormant since Feb 2026); storing master API keys in SaaS eval platforms; "accuracy" claims without CIs
- The concise skills section for this role: [résumé skills matrix](../../06-job-search/resume-skills-matrix.md#resume-ai-evaluation-engineer).
